alerts.title: Proteinuria mentioned in notes
alerts.message: Proteinuria (or trace protein) is mentioned in notes. Consider follow-up assessment and management per local guidance.

alerts.title: Renal Function Decline
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend monitoring renal function in patients on TDF. Patient's creatinine levels have been rising over the years (0.9 in 2020 to 1.4 in 2026), indicating a decline in renal function. This could be due to TDF toxicity, but other factors like dehydration or comorbidities should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor eGFR and creatinine levels regularly
